<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z ≈ 199, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 197.99 Da. A plausible organic formula that matches this mass within typical experimental error is C₁₀H₁₄O₄ (exact neutral mass = 198.089 Da, giving [M+H]⁺ ≈ 199.097 Da, close to the observed 198.999 Da). Therefore the molecular formula is reported as C10H14O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H14O4</final_answer>
